simple.meaning: עַתּוּד (ʻattûwd) appears 29 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with flocks. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Psalms, Proverbs, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 31:10. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, flock, offering, sacrifice.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַתּוּד (H6260) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עַתּוּד through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עַתּוּד (ʻattûwd) / H6260 is tracked through Genesis 31:10, Genesis 31:12, Numbers 7:17, Numbers 7:23. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

Numbers 7; Psa 66:15 and (ironic) 50:9 ; 50:13 ; figurative of people and princes in ׳י 's great sacrifice Isa 34:6 ; Jer 51:40 (simile), Ezek 39:18 , and (idea of sacrifice dropped) Zech 10:3 . עִתִּי עַתַּי, עַתָּה, see עֵת below I. ענה .
